business_problem: In order to modernize its frontend stack, Asana needed to finish a long-running code migration that was still years from completion. At its prior pace—with only a few engineers working on the migration incrementally alongside other priorities—Asana projected that it would take roughly five more years to complete.

At its prior pace—with only a few engineers working on the migration incrementally alongside other priorities—Asana projected that it would take roughly five more years to complete. With Codex, Asana completed the project in about two weeks. Asana helps teams coordinate work. Its platform uses AI agents and automations to help customers manage, track, and execute that work. Asana brings the same approach to its engineering organization, where people use OpenAI Codex, powered by frontier models, to tackle large codebase changes, then review and approve each proposed change.
